Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made an error in the analysis of the extracted text. Specifically, it misinterpreted the text "Turn 82 into an improper fraction (3 35 x $58)" as a valid problem involving forming an improper fraction. This text appears to be nonsensical or incorrectly extracted due to OCR errors, and it should not have been counted as a valid problem. As a result, the Orchestrator incorrectly calculated the total score by including two improper fraction problems instead of one. This mistake led to an inflated score of 55 instead of the correct score of 40 (20 points for the mixed number problem, 15 points for one valid improper fraction problem, and 5 bonus points).
